why: Raised for #208: Jake's frostbite (nightOrder) has to live from the crash through every Act 3 branch to a4_news, which nearly doubles the Act 3 tail. Limits sit about 20% over the new baseline for states and under the 1.5 GB old-space cap for heap, so a blow-up still fails here with a message rather than as an out-of-memory crash. The next field that spans Act 3 needs liveness work, not another raise.
